audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Ziggs six of seven stages on the strength of an 8-game 75% figure, while the mirror set the opposite chart from a much larger sample.
audit.why: The mirror audit (chogath__ziggs) set Skill / Ziggs / Ziggs / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath after correcting the range error that this page is also built on. Cho'Gath grows with every Feast stack and Ziggs' chip does not stop it, so the late stages belong to him. Restating the mirror's chart from this side keeps the two pages consistent; ratings are inverted.
audit.corrected: win[0]/phases[0] Skill, win[1-2] Ziggs, win[3-6] Cho'Gath, ratings 5/7/7/4/3/3/2.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags zero cooldown-sequencing advice on the entire page, and the first-item spike names Luden's/Liandry's while the rest of the page builds Blackfire Torch.
audit.why: Rupture is a flat 6s at every rank, Feral Scream is 11s at rank 1, Vorpal Spikes drops to 4s, and Feast is 80/70/60s. The 6s window after a spent Rupture is the only concrete step-up cue in this lane and it was never stated.
audit.corrected: dosFull[0].d and spikes[0].text now sequence off Rupture's 6s; spikes[2].text switched to Blackfire Torch and given Feral Scream's 300 range.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page is built on the claim that Ziggs out-ranges Cho'Gath's whole kit. Rupture is 950 and Bouncing Bomb is 850 — he out-ranges you. Feast is also described as an execute and wants.you[2] never says why it hurts.
audit.why: Rupture at 950 means the poke war is his to open, and the answer is angles and the 6s downtime rather than raw distance. Feral Scream silences at 300 range, which denies the Satchel Charge cast — your only self-displacement, on 20s at rank 1 — so his all-in is Rupture into a walk-up silence. Feast is 175-range true damage that ignores every point of MR you buy and permanently grows his health when it kills.
audit.corrected: tldr, whys[1], spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text, wants.you[1], wants.you[2] and dontsFull[0].d rebuilt on the real ranges, the silence-denies-Satchel interaction and Feast's true damage.

edits.before: Free poke lane — win by denying farm and rotating R, not by trying to kill a raid boss.
edits.after: Rupture reaches 950 to your 850 — deny farm and rotate R; you cannot kill a raid boss.

edits.before: At level 2 Ziggs still out-ranges everything Cho owns and chunks him on every step-up.
edits.after: At level 2 his 950 Rupture out-ranges you, so bomb from the side and never stand still.

edits.before: Cho'Gath has no gap-closer and no ranged poke besides Rupture (Q), a slow telegraphed pillar you sidestep on sight. Sit at max Bouncing Bomb (Q) range and chunk him every time he steps up to last-hit; his only sustain is stacking Feast, which he can't do if you're zoning the wave.
edits.after: Rupture (Q) reaches 950 against your 850, so max range is his, not yours — bomb from an angle, sidestep the pillar, and step up only in the 6 seconds after he spends it. His sustain is Carnivore off minion kills, so zoning him off the wave is what actually starves him.

edits.before: Rushing Luden's or Liandry's, your Q spam out-DPSes his passive HP regen. Drop Hexplosive Minefield (E) between you and him so his only engage — walking up for Silence (W) — costs him a huge chunk and a slow he can't afford.
edits.after: With Blackfire Torch your Q spam out-DPSes Carnivore's regen. Drop Hexplosive Minefield (E) between you and him: Feral Scream (W) is only 300 range and silences the Satchel out of your hands, so make those 300 units expensive.

edits.before: E minefield walled between you and his Silence range
edits.after: E minefield between you and his 300-range Feral Scream

edits.before: Never standing in point-blank R execute range at low HP
edits.after: Never inside 175 units of him — Feast is pure true damage

edits.before: Telegraphed knockup — sidestep it and he has no engage at all. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Rupture is a flat 6s and reaches 950 — sidestep the pillar, then step up during its downtime, not before.

edits.before: That is Cho'Gath’s rehearsed moment — don’t audition for it.
edits.after: Feast is true damage on 80s — resistances will not save you.

notes: Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES (Hexplosive Minefield is the real name with a verb in front). The level chart is proposed as one atomic paired group following the mirror's chart; if the user prefers the 8-game 75% figure over the mirror's larger sample, drop the whole group rather than part of it. Separate inconsistency the applier cannot fix: diff is "HARD" while tone is the green favoured colour, diffRating is 4/10 and breakdown.difficulty/report[14] both say "Favoured matchup" — and after this chart change none of them match the chart either. See questionsForUser. The label "Rupture (Knockup)" clutters roughly fifteen full-layer fields; a global label pass would be cleaner than prose rewrites.
